movement-along.def: A move from one point to another on the same curve, caused by a change in a variable on one of the graph's axes, such as the price of the good.

curve-shift.def: The whole curve moving to a new position because something other than the graphed variables changed; right means a larger quantity at every price, left a smaller one.

ceteris-paribus.def: Latin for "other things equal": the rule that a curve holds every influence fixed except the two variables it graphs.
